Dated: 31/03/2026
CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK
This is to certify that the work of “Hospital Block — Rajasthan Pkg-53” (buildings), awarded to M/s
National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been completed in
all respects on 28/07/2015 at a gross executed value of INR 9.03 Cr (Rupees 9.03 Crore Only).
The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on satisfactory
completion of the final inspection.
The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Kavita Reddy. This certificate is issued for record and for
submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
Executive Engineer
Central Works & Buildings Bureau
